top_signals.title: Statement by President von der Leyen with NATO Secretary-General Mark Rutte
top_signals.summary: European Commission Statement Brussels, 02 Sep 2026 We meet today to discuss Russia's attack in Leipzig. The German government has identified Russia as behind an attempt to attack cargo planes at Leipzig/Halle Airport. Had this attack succeeded, this would have resulted in enormous damage and possibly even loss of life. So I want to be very clear about what this was. This was an attack using military-grade material, carried out by Russian operatives on EU soil.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
top_signals.summary: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.summary: The integration lets Bybit users spend digital assets directly from their exchange balances across Mesh-powered platforms.
